# ohAegRsaDecText

ohAegRsaDecText(text: string \| Uint8Array, priKey: string \| Uint8Array): Promise\<string\>

RSA3072私钥解密算法，配套[ohAegRsaEncText](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/AppGallery-connect-References/ohaegrsaenctext-0000001864467536)接口使用，密钥类型、填充模式、摘要算法等如下：  

|非对称密钥类型|填充模式|摘要算法|掩码摘要|API版本|
|:------|:---------|:-----|:----------|:----|
|RSA3072|PKCS1_OAEP|SHA256|MGF1_SHA256|11+|

导入模块：

```
import { AegRsa } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';
```

参数：  

|参数名|类型|必填|说明|
|:-----|:----------------|:-|:-------------------------------|
|text|string或Uint8Array|是|待解密的内容（使用ohAegRsaEncText加密后的结果）。|
|priKey|string或Uint8Array|是|RSA私钥，base64编码过的字符串或Uint8Array。|

返回值：  

|参数|类型|说明|
|:----------|:-----|:---------|
|decryptText|String|解密后的明文字符串。|

示例：

```
import { AegRsa } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';

async function rsa3072_1() {
  let plainText = 'hello world'; //待加密内容
  //用于加密的公钥，长度3027位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let pubKey = '';
  //用于解密的私钥，长度3072位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let priKey = '';


  try {
    let encryptText = await AegRsa.ohAegRsaEncText(plainText, pubKey);
    //rsa3072_1  encryptText: 102,21,91,71,191,124,60,74,65,43,53,141,77,84,103,230,232,90,89,187,124,38,74,211,25,255,163,187,93,60,43,17,32,235,116,228,113,71,179,237,71,202,157,42,24,86,40,135,161,133,184,76,115,174,86,88,40,79,128,221,111,21,127,69,214,86,112,58,90,118,194,1,128,5,203,208,253,14,149,19,48,150,2,154,126,148,0,41,118,2,249,140,225,3,59,244,152,208,109,78,90,226,238,212,9,54,23,208,217,114,31,205,232,156,41,58,254,143,86,233,204,61,34,204,186,189,86,169,251,31,44,106,158,203,4,122,156,159,83,231,159,231,43,179,48,27,58,250,137,167,173,14,210,191,233,238,93,18,73,112,91,144,247,153,57,226,24,143,251,27,113,83,186,246,176,141,111,237,135,175,40,174,50,147,114,247,55,202,93,222,76,240,64,162,26,118,48,137,14,44,192,107,217,225,31,137,93,157,253,196,228,214,27,117,98,75,147,214,78,64,47,107,240,213,72,0,68,195,40,143,173,132,255,154,9,248,150,118,146,172,82,126,214,192,73,103,102,111,10,173,161,129,212,189,146,11,81,124,11,43,30,149,21,202,178,185,223,121,223,115,212,57,58,165,218,126,141,153,120,106,173,32,176,60,132,79,225,166,51,64,185,80,247,31,124,135,200,163,12,234,236,155,106,147,3,86,152,18,209,92,119,165,133,152,72,58,227,29,242,127,18,147,118,148,6,205,52,207,12,41,225,218,126,12,127,63,29,46,72,243,234,65,186,60,240,197,206,216,205,227,150,187,224,78,59,205,179,154,206,222,241,202,50,120,150,143,56,219,169,143,7,136,153,133,31,64,224,64,88,236,104,222,130,152
    console.log("rsa3072_1 ", 'encryptText: ' + encryptText);

    let decryptText = await AegRsa.ohAegRsaDecText(encryptText, priKey);
    if (plainText === decryptText) {
      console.info('rsa3072_1 decrypt ok');
    }
    console.log("rsa3072_1 ", 'decryptText: ' + decryptText);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("rsa3072_1 ", 'err: ' + err);
  }
}
```
